g.title: Waiting hall / shelter: Waiting benches, luggage crates and a room now used as an overnight shelter.
North-bank family home: A family dining room looking down toward the bridge.
Quay tool shed: Rope and repair supplies are represented by a bench, toolbox and packed chest.
Dry warehouse: Cargo rescued from the low quay is stacked on the dry side of the road.
Customs house / lookout: Records and inspection tables below; a bridge-facing office above.
House / first-aid post: A family home converted to a two-bed first-aid post.
Vacated quay house: The household has packed; only a bare table and an open chest remain.
Bridge kitchen: A shared kitchen provides a reason for people on both banks to keep the bridge open.
Shelter store: Dry bedding and relief supplies, represented by stacked crates and chests.
